Home - Imvelo Safari Lodges
Timeless Traditions
Authentic Connections
Safaris with Purpose + Passion
Connecting People And Nature
Imvelo Safari Lodges offer five special camps in and around Hwange National Park, Zimbabwe— welcoming creature comforts combine with the luxury of exclusivity , remote places, small intimate camps , and authentic interactions with nature and local people. We believe in enriching the lives of those who live around us as well as our guests. We aim to ensure that the local communities and wildlife benefit directly from you , our visitors. This is where we excel .
Our Camps
Our Style
Our Impact
Big 5 in Hwange!
In 2022, Imvelo successfully brought rhino back to Hwange !
After a journey of 17+ hours and 700+ kilometers across Zimbabwe, the first two white rhino to roam Hwange in decades have settled into their new home at the Imvelo Ngamo Wildlife Sanctuary .
Guests staying at Bomani or Camelthorn will have the opportunity to potentially see the Big5!
Learn More
Shake Up Your Safari
In addition to classic game drives , take a ride on our Elephant Express , photograph from our underground look-up blinds , play an active part in wildlife protection , pedal through the park on a biking safari , activate all of your senses on a walking safari , and so much more!
Coupled with our incredibly impactful community and conservation programs and immersive cultural activities, we know that doing things differently offers a varied and unique safari experience .

Our Camps
Timeless Traditions
Imvelo Safari Lodges’ forest villas, unique treehouses and safari lodges are built in nature’s most pristine and splendid settings— boasting prolific wildlife, quintessential vistas, and each one has a powerful and positive impact on the local communities. We have struck the perfect balance of the safari days of old with just the right touch of lavishness.
Our five properties are designed to be combined for a varied and vibrant safari in Zimbabwe’s celebrated Hwange National Park.
Explore Bomani Tented Camp
Explore Camelthorn Lodge
Explore Nehimba Lodge
Explore Jozibanini Tented Camp
Explore Tum Tum Treehouse Lodge
Our Style
Authentic Connections
From a ride on our one-of-a-kind Elephant Express (a unique railcar, ingeniously designed and built to offer an unforgettable activity) to game viewing from strategically placed look up hides (close-up photography like you’ve never imagined!) to tracking wildlife on foot (including reintroduced white rhino) to meaningful and unchoreographed community visits, we aim to shake up your safari!
Our days are flexible and whether you elect traditional game drives or one of our more innovative experiences, your experiences will be genuine and exceptional.
Explore All Activities
Our Impact
Safaris with Purpose and Passion
At the core of Imvelo Safari Lodges is a commitment to protect our treasured environment and natural resources and empower local people, our neighbors, in the surrounding areas. Driven by the generous heart and creative minds of dedicated staff, community, and safari guests, what we have been able to accomplish in our decade’s long effort is astounding. We invite you to learn about our myriad projects completed and join us with those we continue to pursue.

Our Camps - Imvelo Safari Lodges
Our Camps
Wild Comfort
Each of our safari lodges and camps has been meticulously designed to wrap you in comfort , a splash of luxury, and an exciting dash of uniqueness . The locations have been carefully selected for two vital reasons: the local community’s dedication to our conservation partnership and the proximity to some of nature’s most impressive wonders , in and around Hwange National Park. Each property has a style of its own , making it easy and fun to combine two or three of the camps for an incredible safari experience.
Check Availability
Nehimba Lodge
Living with Elephants
Nestled away on a remote private concession in the northern part of Hwange National Park, Nehimba Lodge combines comfort, elegance, and African charm for an exceptional safari experience. Nine spacious canvas under thatch tents are built on teak decks and overlook a magnificent waterhole that is frequented by large numbers of elephants.
Explore
Camelthorn Lodge
Living Under the Acacias
Our flagship lodge is hidden in a stand of pristine woodland just west of the famous Ngamo Plains on the edge of Hwange National Park. The lodge is unique in its style and design and has as its centerpiece a huge ancient Camelthorn tree. Strategically situated to explore this remote portion of the park, Camelthorn offers a spectacular wilderness experience.
Explore
Bomani Tented Camp
Living on the Plains
Bomani Tented Camp is situated in a private concession of the magnificent Ngamo Plains, on the edge of the remote and unspoilt southeastern corner of Hwange National Park. Bomani is famous for its unique scenery as well as its large herds of elephants and a host of animals and resident birdlife. A safari experience you won’t soon forget!
Explore
Jozibanini Camp
Living in the Wilderness
Jozibanini Camp is situated in one of the most untouched areas of Southern Hwange National Park. This is a small, exclusive camp in a spectacularly wild place—incredible for anyone looking for a unique and untamed wilderness experience. Time seems to stand still at Jozi, almost impossible to describe—memories made here will linger a long time.
Explore
Tum Tum Treehouse Lodge
Living under the Canopy
Perched among teak and camelthorn woodlands in south-eastern Hwange, Tum Tum Treehouse Lodge features four elevated treehouses each 5 to 7 metres above the ground and a spacious family tent on a raised wooden platform (1 metre above ground level) for up to six guests. Crafted from wood and canvas with glass sliding doors, these airy, elevated tents afford safari goers the opportunity to observe wildlife including elephants wandering beneath the rooms.
Explore
WHY HWANGE NATIONAL PARK?
With 14 651 square kilometers of wilderness to explore, Hwange National Park is bigger than the Serengeti National Park.
For Hwange’s impressive size, the per annum visitor numbers are small in contrast to the density of travelers to parks such as the Serengeti, Masai Mara, and Kruger—it is likely you will spend most of your safari without seeing other vehicles except those from the lodge you are staying at—an exclusive experience indeed!
Hwange National Park is easy to reach from Victoria Falls by air in a private charter or a combination of road and the unique Elephant Express railcar transfer.
Hwange is home to approximately 46 000 elephants, compared with Masai Mara at 3 700, Kruger at 13 750 and Serengeti at 2 100. In the dry season in Hwange, it is likely you will see elephants numbering in the hundreds congregating at waterpoints. Amazingly there are more elephants than guests visiting Hwange National Park in a year!
Hwange National Park offers exceptional game viewing year-round and is one of the best parks in Africa for diversity of wildlife and within Zimbabwean parks, the largest species diversity and populations of sable, cheetah, wild dog, and lion.
Hwange’s Professional Guides serve apprenticeships lasting between 5 and 10 years and their skills are recognized as among the best in Africa.

Bomani Tented Lodge - Imvelo Safari Lodges
Bomani Tented Lodge
Living on the Plains
A safari classic! Bomani Tented Camp is nestled in a private concession on the splendid Ngamo Plains —legendary for unique scenery and impressive year-round game viewing with a great diversity of wildlife in substantial numbers. Enjoy an open-air thatched main lodge, tented accommodations, teak viewing decks, a prolific waterhole, splash pool, and evenings around the fire— this is living on the plains . Your days unfold as you wish , each experience is tailored to your interests and our expert, fun, and friendly guides are simply the best! At Bomani, expect great year-round game viewing , a plethora of safari activities , and an enormous commitment to local communities and wildlife .

Conservation + Community
Connecting People and Nature
The natural beauty and diverse wildlife of Hwange National Park attracts visitors who are eager to enjoy and ensure it is protected well into the future.
Proud guardians, the local community support conservation bringing sustainable livelihoods and critical social services like healthcare, education, and clean water.
Just by enjoying an Imvelo safari, every traveler helps finance conservation and community initiatives and provides ‘boots on the ground’ support in ensuring safe havens for wildlife.
Imvelo Safari Lodges knows that engaging and empowering local communities bordering national parks is the first and most important step in conservation. To that end, we have an exhaustive list of thoughtful, innovative, and impactful programs in place to achieve our goals—many of which you can choose to be an active part of!

Bomani Tented Camp
Camp Life
Camp life at Bomani harkens back to simpler days—so leave your devices and schedules behind and gather around the fire to sip your coffee with the sunrise or to swap stories after dark!
The main lodge is traditional safari style with an open fronted thatch building and adjoining teak viewing deck that overlooks the productive lodge waterhole. This common space is home to the bar, lounge, and dining area—though most meals are enjoyed al fresco. A splash pool set in a raised deck offers a refreshing welcome midday and in-house spa treatments are available on request at an extra cost.
The best part of the Bomani experience is that you can really make it what you want—head out at dawn as day breaks over Hwange or have a sleep in and bring your paint supplies to the look up blind for a late morning of art and wildlife. Our guides and camp staff explain all your options and help you plan out your ideal experience.
Watch Video

Camelthorn Lodge - Imvelo Safari Lodges
Camelthorn Lodge
Living Under the Acacias
Camelthorn Lodge is nestled into a beautiful forest adjacent to Hwange National Park’s famous Ngamo Plains. The lodge is unique in style and design and has a particularly meaningful story behind it —built for and by the community whose land it calls home. An ancient Camelthorn tree , the property’s namesake, is the centerpiece with the main lodge and eight beautiful villas flowing around it. Enjoy al fresco dining , sip your morning coffee in front of a roaring fire , track herds of elephant by foot, and enjoy close-up photography from inside our look-up blind. A spectacular wilderness experience —this flagship lodge is the perfect homebase for an immersive safari experience.

Camelthorn Lodge
Camp Life
In the cool woodlands on the southern edge of Ngamo’s famous Plains, Camelthorn Lodge is all about adding an extra touch of comfort and style to a memorable safari experience. The shade-throwing centerpiece Camelthorn tree is naturally the main gathering point—it looks particularly beautiful when lit up at night with hanging lanterns. The cozy forest lodge feel is further noticeable with a massive hearth in the dining room, and fireplaces in each villa, as well—a lovely way to warm up during the winter months in Hwange.
Meals are served a variety of ways and may be family style, in the bush or privately at your villa. Evening always ends around the welcoming firepit and is enjoyed by all. Wonderful birdlife and woodland animals—and possibly even rhinos—can be seen on the grounds of the lodge, while visiting the Sanctuary headquarters and the neighboring villages will provide a special dimension to your safari.
Watch Video
Camelthorn Lodge
The Villas
Accommodation at Camelthorn Lodge is in eight spacious villas, each beautifully appointed with wonderful beds, sitting areas inside and out, a fireplace, large soaking tub, and walk-in shower.
